messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: staged rollout v2.3.8 -> 15% traffic (eu-west) at 2026-03-19T14:00:00Z. Details: https://internal.releases/redwood/v2.3.8 :rocket:
maria: Quick context: this is the latency-optimized runtime change (kv-cache tweak + kernel fallback) — low risk but changed batching defaults. release notes here: https://go/release/v2.3.8-notes
alex: Ping ops/sre: what are our explicit stop criteria for this canary? I thought we had 3% error increase or 120ms p95 bump as hard stops
jamal: Seeing a small uptick in 5xx in eu-west-most edge (hostset eu5) at T+3m, +1.8% so far. Not yet at threshold but wanted to call out.
sre-bot: ALERT: error_rate(eu-west, 1m) = +1.9% vs baseline. p95_latency(eu-west, 1m) = +35ms.
maria: Thanks @jamal. Can we snapshot logs for the affected nodes? `sudo journalctl -u inference-runtime | grep kvcache`
jamal: grabbing now, one sec
jamal: log snippet: ```Mar 19 14:03:11 runtime[pid]: kvcache miss spike shard=7 size=12ms
Mar 19 14:03:13 runtime[pid]: fallback to generic kernel seq=512```
leah: From product/QoS: if errors <3% and p95 < 120ms we should be fine. This looks within acceptable range but keep monitoring.
maria: Ops, suggest we HOLD at 15% for an extra 10m while we validate the kvcache spill behavior. If it stays steady we can continue ramp to 50%.
ops: I support holding. If it trends up we should pin back to v2.3.7 for eu-west only. Command to pin: `deploy pin --version v2.3.7 --region eu-west`
alex: +1 hold. Also can we enable `--circuit-breaker=aggressive` for the canary so that client retries don't amplify errors?
maria: I'll enable the circuit-breaker flag for current canary slice: `api update-rollout --id r-9945 --flags circuit_breaker=aggressive`
leah: Quick vote: proceed ramp after 10m if metrics stable? React with :thumbsup: to proceed, :thumbsdown: to rollback.
jamal: :thumbsup: monitoring
ops: :thumbsdown: prefer pin if any more growth in errors
sre-bot: METRIC SNAPSHOT (T+10m): error_rate(eu-west) = +1.6%; p95 = +40ms; infra_cpu = stable. No new OOMs.
maria: Given snapshot and votes, holding for a final 5m then ramp to 50% if metrics stay within thresholds. I'll post a short rollout note when we start the ramp.
leah: Thanks all. If anything crosses thresholds call the rollback explicitly.
jamal: noted — will escalate right away if it moves.
deploy-bot: Action taken: rollout paused at 15% by maria at 2026-03-19T14:10:00Z. Next check in 5m.
